name: @uni-helper/devtools-devframe
description: Uni-Helper DevTools backend integration and devframe definition for Devframe / Hub ecosystem

scripts.build: pnpm run build:plugin && pnpm run build:agent-vue2 && pnpm run build:webpack
scripts.build:plugin: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:vite --outfile=dist/plugin.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __uniCr}from'node:module';import{fileURLToPath as __uniFu}from'node:url';import{dirname as __uniDn}from'node:path';const require=__uniCr(import.meta.url);const __filename=__uniFu(import.meta.url);const __dirname=__uniDn(__filename);" && esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vite --define:import.meta.url=__uniImportMetaUrl --banner:js="const __uniImportMetaUrl = require('node:url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --outfile=dist/plugin.cjs && rm -rf dist/client && cp -R node_modules/vite-plugin-inspect/dist/client dist/client
scripts.build:webpack: esbuild src/webpack.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:webpack --external:devframe --external:"devframe/*" --outfile=dist/webpack.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __uniCr}from'node:module';import{fileURLToPath as __uniFu}from'node:url';import{dirname as __uniDn}from'node:path';const require=__uniCr(import.meta.url);const __filename=__uniFu(import.meta.url);const __dirname=__uniDn(__filename);" && esbuild src/webpack.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:webpack --external:devframe --external:"devframe/*" --define:import.meta.url=__uniImportMetaUrl --banner:js="const __uniImportMetaUrl = require('node:url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --outfile=dist/webpack.cjs
